case_selection: Exactly the nine case_id values beginning R-; unchanged B, T, input, hidden, output, density and workload_ids; no new Cartesian combinations or refinements in this queue.

input.dtype: integer counts in common JSON; cast IEEE float64 for compute
input.stream: One PCG64 default_rng(SeedSequence([seed, 101, sample_index])) per batch sample; choice over shape (T,128). Sampling a shorter T gives an exact prefix of the longer sequence for that same sample.
input.coupling: Within a seed, input arrays at equal T are identical for every N and p; temporal scans share per-sample prefixes. Network and optimizer initial state do not depend on T.

topology.feedforward: All input->hidden and all hidden->output directed edges; explicit target-major edge lists with source-major dense bank parameter_ids, matching the qualified graph convention.
topology.recurrent_candidates: All N*N directed hidden->hidden ordered pairs including diagonal self-connections; no parallel edges.
topology.recurrent_edge_sampling: Independent Bernoulli(p) for every candidate, generated one target row at a time. For target j use default_rng(SeedSequence([seed,202,N,j])).random(N) < p. Keep sources in ascending order; concatenate targets in ascending order.
topology.density_one: The p=1 case includes all N*N candidate edges, including the diagonal; it is still the explicit-edge graph view.
topology.density_coupling: For fixed seed,N, the same uniforms generate nested p=.01,.1,1 topologies. Record actual E, density E/(N*N), self-edge count and per-target indegrees; do not assert exact p*N indegree.
topology.parameter_sharing: No recurrent tying: each retained edge has one independent parameter bank index 0..E-1 in (target,source) order.
topology.self_connection_evidence: The frozen E3/E6/E7 source specifies density but does not prescribe self inclusion/exclusion. The no-self rule found in semantic-contracts.json applies only to L2. Inclusion here is a proposed new explicit decision and needs confirmation; the existing Q0 recurrent graph includes diagonal edges.
topology.delay: No delay buffers. All groups drift and threshold first; all feedforward and recurrent additions follow, influencing the next threshold stage.

initialization.recurrent_bank: For target j, default_rng(SeedSequence([seed,305,N,j])).normal(0,1,size=N), retain the same Bernoulli edge mask and multiply by sqrt(2/max(1,p*N)).
initialization.recurrent_normalization_note: Expected-fan-in normalization is a proposed policy, not specified by the original source. It changes deterministically with p before any results exist; common surviving edges share standard-normal draws but their scale differs with p. Report spike counts/rates; do not interpret density scans as activity-matched timing.
initialization.state: All initial voltages zero for every sample and every public train call; no implicit carry between global batches.
initialization.dynamics: beta=.95, threshold=1, strict >, subtract reset with stopped spike VJP, slope-5 fast sigmoid surrogate, logits=5*mean(output_spikes), global-batch mean CE
initialization.optimizer: Adam float64 parameters and moments, lr=.001, beta1=.9, beta2=.999, eps=1e-8, eps_root=0, no decay; one optimizer step per full global batch.

qualification_and_admission.oracle: Existing independent NumPy graph forward_vjp; actual competitor cells/transforms via the qualified graph_competitor adapter.
qualification_and_admission.scope: Full-size per-case qualification of states, spikes, logits, CE loss, initial VJP, each bank gradient, local surrogate VJP, one SGD update and three Adam steps. Diagnostics are not performance scores.
qualification_and_admission.atlas: Exact current-request canonical JSON bytes and v2 graph tape formula before each attempted native update; retain earlier admitted/executed steps when a later optimizer state exceeds 64 MiB. A software budget rejection is never a physical OOM.
qualification_and_admission.no_reduction: No microbatching, shorter T, smaller N/B, pruning, TBPTT, or removal of self edges in response to a result.
qualification_and_admission.admission_only: Optional separate exact-admission queue over all nine cases/five seeds; it does not qualify an engine or manufacture a native execution result.

proposed_queue.first_stage: Prepare fixtures and exact Atlas admission, then bounded qualification; no recurrent performance timings claimed by this initial queue.
proposed_queue.scope_note: 9 cases * 5 views * 5 seeds; every cell retains an explicit outcome, including unqualified, timeout, software rejection and OOM. Shared fixture preparation and admission work are recorded separately.
proposed_queue.rss_guard_decision: Needs confirmation: a 64 GiB contemporaneous process-tree RSS guard protects the shared 128 GiB host; a guard-triggered kill would be resource_limit, never physical OOM or an engine capacity failure.
proposed_queue.hardware_disclosure: Only user-selected 100.90.28.27 host; same E1 environment settings. JAX worker pool is not confined to one CPU by OMP=1. RSS contains qualification and compilation artifacts and is not training-only memory.
proposed_queue.concurrency: No remote preparation, admission counting, compilation, qualification or performance while the ongoing E1-small/E1-large performance phase is active.

confirmation_required_for: Bernoulli per-candidate sparse sampling rather than fixed edge count or fixed indegree
Include self-connections (the original R source leaves this unspecified)
Independent coupled RNG streams preserving temporal prefixes and fixed network across T
64 GiB process-tree RSS guard and separate resource_limit outcome
225 full-size seed/view qualification cells with 22.5-hour maximum active budget, within the existing 72-hour CPU reservation
